fresno.name: Fresno

climate.notes: Hot dry summers, mild winters with tule fog. IP67-rated track engineered for 115°F+ summer heat.

fresno.testimonialQuote: I absolutely love our lights. The app is awesome and installation was perfect. Amazing customer service. Definitely went above and beyond.
fresno.intro: Fresno is the heart of the Central Valley and Twilight Zone's home base. We've installed permanent outdoor lights on more Fresno homes than any other zip code — from single-story ranches in Sunnyside to two-story custom estates in Woodward Park.
fresno.popular: Most-requested in Fresno: warm-white architectural accent year-round, with Christmas red-and-green and Bulldogs red-and-blue auto-scheduled by date and game-day.

clovis.name: Clovis

climate.notes: Slightly cooler than central Fresno but same Central Valley climate. Winter fog common; LED systems unaffected.

clovis.testimonialQuote: We've really enjoyed our Twilight Zone Christmas Lighting. Love the daily Accent and Game Day features. Kids have fun creating custom patterns.
clovis.intro: Clovis is one of California's fastest-growing cities and Twilight Zone's #2 install market. New construction in Loma Vista and Harlan Ranch frequently includes permanent lighting from day one.
clovis.popular: Most-requested in Clovis: full-perimeter installs on new construction homes, with Buchanan Bears blue-and-gold or Clovis North Broncos colors auto-scheduled for Friday game nights.

madera.name: Madera

climate.notes: Madera is the gateway to Yosemite. Tesoro Viejo's elevation gives mild evenings. Same IP67 rating handles year-round.

madera.testimonialQuote: Installed under the eaves a year ago and love them. Just added Landscape in the yard, and Patio Lights over the pool. Best toy I've ever owned.
madera.intro: Madera homes — especially in master-planned communities like Tesoro Viejo and Riverstone — favor architectural permanent lighting that shows off the modern designs year-round.
madera.popular: Most-requested in Madera: warm-white architectural accent for new-build estates and full-property landscape integration in Tesoro Viejo.

visalia.name: Visalia

climate.notes: Tulare County agricultural valley. Visalia gets heavy winter tule fog — permanent lighting cuts through it where seasonal lights struggle.

visalia.testimonialQuote: If anyone is looking for a year-round lighting system, call Twilight Zone. Best investment we've made. 5-star service, no hidden fees.
visalia.intro: Visalia is the largest city in Tulare County and our southern install hub. Visalia winters bring heavy tule fog that defeats string lights — permanent track shines through it.
visalia.popular: Most-requested in Visalia: cool-white security lighting for rural property and Redwood Rangers cardinal-and-gold game-day for school spirit.

hanford.name: Hanford

climate.notes: Hanford sits in Kings County agricultural land. Hot dry summers, occasional foggy winter mornings.

hanford.testimonialQuote: Was skeptical about the invisible-by-day part. I was wrong. You literally cannot see them unless you're 6 feet away looking up. At night? Movie set.
hanford.intro: Hanford is the seat of Kings County and Twilight Zone's southwestern service hub. We serve residential and commercial properties from Hanford East to Downtown.
hanford.popular: Most-requested in Hanford: holiday-rotation packages and Hanford Bullpups red-and-blue for game day weekends.

sanger.name: Sanger

climate.notes: Sanger sits at the foothills entrance to the Sierra. Slightly cooler evenings than central Fresno.

sanger.testimonialQuote: Best part: I'll never put up Christmas lights again. Second-best: Bulldogs red and blue every Saturday. Third-best: my wife thinks I'm a hero now.
sanger.intro: Sanger is Twilight Zone's foothills service market. We've served homes from Sanger Heights down to the Old Town district.
sanger.popular: Most-requested in Sanger: full Halloween-into-Christmas seasonal rotation packages.

selma.name: Selma

climate.notes: Selma is the 'Raisin Capital of the World' — agricultural Central Valley climate. Hot summers, foggy winters.

selma.testimonialQuote: Quoted me $4,200 less than the competitor and the install quality is noticeably better. They actually showed up on time, finished in one day.
selma.intro: Selma is Twilight Zone's southern Fresno County market. Most installs here are residential single-story ranches with full-perimeter holiday rotation.
selma.popular: Most-requested in Selma: Christmas auto-schedule from November 15 through January 5 and Selma Bears black-and-gold for football season.

reedley.name: Reedley

climate.notes: Reedley sits along the Kings River. Cooler evening breezes than central Fresno but same hot summer days.

reedley.testimonialQuote: Never stepping on a ladder again. Worth every dollar.
reedley.intro: Reedley is Twilight Zone's southeastern foothills market. River-adjacent homes especially benefit from permanent lighting that doesn't require seasonal removal.
reedley.popular: Most-requested in Reedley: warm-white architectural accent year-round and Reedley Pirates red-and-black for game weekends.

kingsburg.name: Kingsburg

climate.notes: Kingsburg is the Swedish-themed agricultural town in southern Fresno County.

kingsburg.testimonialQuote: Auto-scheduled holiday rotation is genius. We never touch it.
kingsburg.intro: Kingsburg is Twilight Zone's southernmost Fresno County market. Mostly residential installs in Heights and Old Town districts.
kingsburg.popular: Most-requested in Kingsburg: holiday rotation auto-schedule and Kingsburg Vikings purple-and-gold.

parlier.name: Parlier

climate.notes: Parlier is the heart of the Fresno County raisin grape country.

parlier.testimonialQuote: Fresno-area family business that actually shows up. Great work.
parlier.intro: Parlier is Twilight Zone's smaller-town Fresno County service market.
parlier.popular: Most-requested in Parlier: warm-white architectural accent year-round.

fowler.name: Fowler

climate.notes: Fowler is a small Central Valley town between Fresno and Selma.

fowler.testimonialQuote: Drove from Fresno to install our place. Best in the Valley.
fowler.intro: Fowler is Twilight Zone's smaller service market between Fresno and Selma.
fowler.popular: Most-requested in Fowler: residential single-story permanent lighting with holiday rotation.

kerman.name: Kerman

climate.notes: Kerman sits west of Fresno in the agricultural Central Valley.

kerman.testimonialQuote: Pro install team showed up on time, got it done in a day. Highly recommend.
kerman.intro: Kerman is Twilight Zone's western Fresno County service area.
kerman.popular: Most-requested in Kerman: residential permanent lighting with seasonal auto-schedules.
